member.name: M:WaterHeaterCommandRequest.#ctor
member.summary:
Controls an ESPHome water-heater entity.
Required: Mode -> include bit 1 in HasFields. TargetTemperature -> bit 2. TargetTemperatureLow -> bit 8. TargetTemperatureHigh -> bit 16. On state -> bit 32. Away state -> bit 64.
State is a bitmask: bit 0 (1) represents away and bit 1 (2) represents on. To explicitly clear away or on, include the corresponding HasFields bit and leave that State bit clear.
HasFields bit 4 is the deprecated combined State selector; prefer the granular OnState and AwayState selectors.

member.name: P:WaterHeaterCommandRequest.DeviceId

member.name: M:SerialProxyRequest.#ctor
member.summary:
